title: ClickHouse query planner 的 mutex 瓶頸與三階段修補
summary: ClickHouse 分區鍵變更導致 part 數量暴增，query planner 的 mutex 競爭使帳單管線停滯，三階段修補讓延遲與 part 數量解耦。
widget_questions: Which component in the ClickHouse query-plan path owns each responsibility, and what does each layer NOT know about the others?
Why does the CPU-mode flame graph mislead the reader to filterPartsByPartition while the Real-mode flame graph reveals the mutex wait?
How sensitive is query latency to part count under each of the four fix tiers (before, shared-lock, cached-vector, binary-search)?
